exercises.instruction: Explosive vertical jump from quarter squat position, focusing on soft landing mechanics
exercises.definition: Plyometric exercise developing lower body power and rate of force development
executionCues: Setup: Feet shoulder-width, quarter squat depth (not deep)
Load: Quick countermovement down to quarter squat, arms swing back
Explode: Drive through floor, extend hips and knees fully, swing arms up
Land: Land softly on balls of feet first, then heels, absorb impact through knees and hips
Reset: Stand fully upright, reset position completely before next rep
Key: Each jump is a complete reset - quality over speed, full recovery between reps

Drive: Explosively extend hips forward, drive knees up and out, swing arms forward
Jump: Aim for maximum horizontal distance, not height
Land: Land with both feet simultaneously, knees over toes, absorb impact
Stick: Hold landing position for 2 seconds - no extra steps, maintain balance
Reset: Walk back to start, full recovery between reps

Flight: Reach forward with arms, bring knees up

exercises.instruction: Cycle through hip, thoracic, and shoulder mobility drills. Hold each position 30-60s, breathing deeply.
exercises.definition: Comprehensive mobility session addressing all major movement patterns
exercises.goal: Restore range of motion, address movement restrictions, and promote tissue recovery through targeted mobility work
exercises.trainerNotes: Mobility work is about quality, not intensity. Breathe deeply into each position. If you feel sharp pain, back off. Mild discomfort is okay, but never force a stretch. Spend extra time on areas that feel restricted.

flowSteps.name: Cat-Cow
flowSteps.cue: Initiate from pelvis, articulate through entire spine
detailedInstructions: Start on hands and knees—wrists under shoulders, knees under hips
COW (Inhale): Tilt pelvis forward, drop belly, lift chest and tailbone
CAT (Exhale): Tuck pelvis under, round spine toward ceiling, tuck chin
Move slowly—feel each vertebra articulate individually
Initiate movement from pelvis, let it ripple through spine
Continue for 15 full cycles, syncing breath with movement

flowSteps.name: Deep Squat Hold with Reach
flowSteps.cue: Heels down, reach one arm up rotating through thoracic
detailedInstructions: Descend into deep squat with heels flat (elevate heels on plate if needed)
Push knees out with elbows, keep chest tall
Reach one arm to ceiling, rotating through thoracic spine
Follow hand with eyes, breathe into the rotation
Hold each side for 30s, then switch
Complete 2 full rounds (90s total each side)

flowSteps.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
flowSteps.cue: Keep chest tall, pause 2s each position
detailedInstructions: Sit with both legs bent at 90°—front shin parallel to front, back shin perpendicular
Front leg is in external rotation, back leg in internal rotation
Keep chest tall and upright throughout
Smoothly switch sides by lifting knees and rotating
Pause 2 seconds in each position, feeling the stretch
Complete 10 switches to each side

flowSteps.name: Thoracic Rotations (Quadruped)
flowSteps.cue: Hand behind head, elbow to sky, exhale into rotation
detailedInstructions: Start in quadruped position (hands and knees)
Place one hand behind your head
Rotate elbow down toward opposite arm (close)
Then rotate elbow up toward ceiling (open)
Exhale as you rotate up, feeling mid-back work
Keep hips stable—only thoracic spine moves
Complete 10 reps per side

flowSteps.name: Shoulder Dislocates
flowSteps.cue: Wide grip, control through full arc
detailedInstructions: Hold band or PVC pipe with very wide grip
Arms straight, band at hip level in front
Slowly arc the band overhead and behind your back
Control the movement—don't force through sticky spots
Reverse direction to return to start
Widen grip if you can't complete full arc pain-free
15 slow, controlled reps

flowSteps.name: Pigeon Pose
flowSteps.cue: Square hips, fold forward, breathe into stretch
detailedInstructions: From hands and knees, bring one knee forward behind wrist
Extend back leg straight behind you
Square hips to front—use block under hip if needed
Walk hands forward, folding chest toward floor
Relax into the stretch, breathe deeply into hip
Hold 2 minutes per side

flowSteps.name: Banded Shoulder Openers
flowSteps.cue: Light band, pull apart with external rotation
detailedInstructions: Hold light resistance band with hands shoulder-width
Pull band apart while externally rotating shoulders
Squeeze shoulder blades together at end range
Control return to start position
10 reps pulling apart, then 10 reps with band behind head

flowSteps.name: Hip Flexor Stretch (Couch Stretch)
flowSteps.cue: Back knee against wall, squeeze glute, upright torso
detailedInstructions: Kneel with back foot against wall (or couch) behind you
Front foot flat on floor, knee over ankle
Squeeze glute of back leg to increase hip flexor stretch
Keep torso upright—don't lean forward
You should feel deep stretch in front of hip and quad
Hold 2 minutes per side, breathing deeply

exercises.name: Recovery Cardio
exercises.notes: Easy walk/hike/bike.
exercises.instruction: Very light movement to promote blood flow and recovery. Keep heart rate below 120 bpm.

exercises.name: Restorative Mobility Flow
exercises.notes: Light, restorative sequence.
exercises.instruction: Gentle mobility work focusing on areas of tightness. Use slow, controlled movements with deep breathing.
exercises.definition: Restorative mobility session for recovery and flexibility maintenance
exercises.goal: Promote deep relaxation, release accumulated tension, and restore the body through gentle, supported positions
exercises.trainerNotes: This is pure recovery work. No effort, no pushing. Let gravity do the work. Use props (pillows, blocks) liberally. If your mind is racing, focus entirely on your breath. This is your time to decompress.

flowSteps.name: Cat-Cow
detailedInstructions: Start on hands and knees, find a comfortable neutral spine
SLOW COW (Inhale 4 counts): Gently drop belly, lift gaze
SLOW CAT (Exhale 6 counts): Round spine, tuck chin
Move at half the speed you think you should
This is about creating space, not stretching hard
10 ultra-slow cycles

flowSteps.name: Child's Pose
flowSteps.cue: Full surrender, let body sink into floor
detailedInstructions: Knees wide apart, big toes touching
Sit hips back toward heels
Walk arms forward, rest forehead on floor (or stacked hands)
Let shoulders completely relax away from ears
Breathe into your lower back
This is complete rest—let go of all holding

flowSteps.name: Thread the Needle
flowSteps.cue: Gentle twist, follow hand with eyes
detailedInstructions: From all fours, slide right arm under body
Right shoulder and ear rest on floor
Left hand can stay in place or walk forward
Feel gentle twist through mid-back
Keep hips squared over knees
Breathe into the space between shoulder blades
90 seconds each side

flowSteps.name: Supine Figure-4 Stretch
flowSteps.cue: Pull gently, keep low back flat
detailedInstructions: Lie on back, both knees bent
Cross right ankle over left knee (figure-4)
Reach through and interlace hands behind left thigh
Gently pull left thigh toward chest
Keep head and shoulders relaxed on floor
Breathe into the outer hip stretch
90 seconds each side

flowSteps.name: Supine Twist
flowSteps.cue: Let knees fall, opposite shoulder stays down
detailedInstructions: Lie on back, hug knees to chest
Let both knees fall to the right
Extend left arm out to side
Turn head to look left (if comfortable)
Keep left shoulder pressing toward floor
Let gravity pull the knees down—don't force
90 seconds each side

flowSteps.name: Happy Baby
flowSteps.cue: Grab feet, gently rock side to side
detailedInstructions: Lie on back, draw knees toward armpits
Reach and grab outside edges of feet
Keep ankles over knees, feet flexed
Gently rock side to side
Let lower back round into floor
Playful, relaxed energy

flowSteps.name: Legs Up Wall
flowSteps.cue: Hips close to wall, arms relaxed, breathe slowly
detailedInstructions: Sit with one hip against wall, swing legs up as you lie back
Scoot hips as close to wall as comfortable
Legs can be together or in a V-shape
Arms out to sides, palms up
Close eyes, breathe slowly and deeply
This inverted position promotes venous return and relaxation

flowSteps.name: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
detailedInstructions: Lie flat on back, legs extended, feet fall open naturally
Arms at sides, palms facing up
Let body become heavy, melting into the floor
Scan from feet to head, releasing any held tension
Breathe naturally—don't control it
This is integration time—let the practice settle in

exercises.instruction: Explosive horizontal jump focusing on hip drive
exercises.definition: Plyometric exercise developing horizontal power transfer
executionCues: Setup: Feet shoulder-width, standing upright
Countermovement: Quick dip down, arms swing back
Drive: Explosively extend hips forward, drive knees up, swing arms forward
Jump: Maximum horizontal distance, not height
Land: Both feet simultaneously, knees over toes
Stick: Hold landing 2 seconds, maintain balance
Reset: Walk back to start, full recovery
